_note: Cross-family blend (Greek + Egyptian): a Ptolemaic realm - a Hellenic ruling dynasty over an Egyptian land, the two religions fused in the temple-cult. Backbone = Hellenic (classical: phonology, the polis-forms, the Basileus ladder); overlay = Egyptian (near_eastern: the river-and-desert land, Per-/Niut- toponyms, the double-crown kingship, the Egyptian temple-substrate). civ = feudal. Seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Greek/Egyptian registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Hellenic primary, Egyptian variant), never real gods.

phonology.palette: Hellenic backbone (a e i o u + long e/o; th/ph/kh; endings -os/-on/-es/-eus) with an Egyptian overlay (dj/tj touches, -aa/-et in the substrate, Per-/Niut- toponyms); theophoric on the Hellenic morphs (Tulrios-, Numenos-) with Egyptian variants.
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; Greek clusters kt/pt/st/ph/th/kh/ps; the Egyptian overlay adds dj/tj and long -aa.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -ides / -ou (son of) + polis demonym; the Egyptian substrate keeps filiation sa-X; the royal house traces the Ptole- dynastic line.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource](stem) + feature with linking -o-; Nea-Polis (new-city); the Egyptian overlay yields Per-[god] and Niut-[god].

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Hellenistic kingdom over an Egyptian land: the Basileus wears the double crown, styled Per-aa to the native temples; the Greek polis-magistracy over the Egyptian nome-substrate)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Hellenic backbone, ascending, with an Egyptian overlay at the nome and the crown. Toparch barony; Phrourarch (garrison-commander) march; Nomarch (governor of an Egyptian nome) county; Strategos (general-governor) duchy; Dynastes (prince) principality; Basileus (king) kingdom; Basileus Megas, styled Per-aa (Pharaoh) to the native temples, over the realm. The Greek court and the Egyptian priesthood share the rule. (Rank titles are the real Greek/Egyptian register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: Greek personal + patronymic (-ides) + polis demonym for the court; the Egyptian substrate keeps theophoric given + filiation (sa-X); the royal line the Ptole- dynastic name.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Greek court uses Hellenic names; the Egyptian commons keep theophoric Egyptian names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Greek names invoke the powers' domains (-machos for war, Sopho- for wisdom); the Egyptian substrate uses X-hotep (X-is-content) on the morphed stems. e.g. Tulrio-doros, Tjuraa-hotep.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (Hellenic primary, from classical theonym treatment; Egyptian variant from near_eastern theonym_sets), never real Greek/Egyptian gods. The Ptolan fuse the two cults (a Serapis-style syncretism): each power has a Hellenic court-name and an Egyptian temple-name, held to be one. Ptolan seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The polis-temple and the Egyptian Per-netjer keep the rites together.
religion.the_one: Aiternos (< Aeternus; Egyptian temple-name Atjernaa) - the One, revered as the Most High when Lawful, acknowledged but set aside when Neutral

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulrios (Egy. Tjuraa) - sun and right-order; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maraxos (Egy. Marakhu) - the war-fire; Chaotic, demonized

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiternos/Atjernaa) and the Lawful powers (Tulrios, Orlandros, Numenos, Gauandos), demonize the Chaotic powers
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent; foreground the deified ancestors (the justified dead) and the local temple-cults of place

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (the Chaotic powers, when Lawful) take dread epithets: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame (Egy. Marakhu the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Wakedjet the Devourer; Lusanto -> Lusandros the Coin-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Temenos (sacred precinct) or Per-netjer (god's-house) of [power]: 'the Temenos of Tulrios', 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa'.
religion.saints_pattern: deified kings and founder-heroes (Greek Heros [name]; Egyptian the justified dead, maa-kheru), venerated at the temple and the royal tomb.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tulrios: a radiate sun above the double crown
holy_symbol_motifs.Realta: a sheltering mother-goddess over the lotus
holy_symbol_motifs.Aiternos: the winged disc above the polis-eagle

banks_patterns.ships: grain-fleet and war-galley names: 'Nike', 'Pride of Ptola', 'Barque of Tjuraa'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [Adjective] Phalanx / the [nome] Companies: 'the Bronze Phalanx', 'the Delta Companies'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: drowned Greek poleis and Egyptian tomb-temples: 'the Labyrinth of Heros [name]', 'the Sunken Per-netjer'
